methods.label: Recognize the doubled expression
methods.explanation:
The distributive property gives \(8x+10\pi=2(4x+5\pi)\). This lets us keep the given expression together:
\[
6(8x+10\pi)
=6\cdot2(4x+5\pi)
=4[3(4x+5\pi)]
=4P.
\]
Thus the answer is \(\boxed{4P}\), choice B.
